messages:
Sam: Quick ask — I need to swap out as facilitator for the Standards sync on Thu 10am (RFC review + design + triage). Can someone pick it up?

Sam: Proposed compact agenda: 
- RFC-452 (kv-cache eviction) — 20m
- Batching design review (perf regs) — 15m
- Quick triage / blockers — 10m

Sam: Also would be great if someone can drop a 1-slide pre-read (one bullet per item). Template: `1-slide -> TL;DR + links + ask`.

Lee: I can take facilitator if nobody else wants it. Happy to run the queue and keep times tight. :+1:

Nina: I can do the 1-slide pre-read for RFC-452. Will pull the key perf graphs and one-liner summary.

Gabi: Heads-up: can we please keep the RFC to 20m strict? last time it ran long. Maybe put followups as async issues.

Sam: Yep, strict timings please. Plan is to surface followups to the triage board (link: https://redwood/boards/standards-triage).

Jon: Quick Q — do we want the batching review to include the kernel selection notes from infra? I can bring the short checklist if useful.

Lee: Yes please include the kernel checklist; makes the perf tradeoffs clearer. Jon, can you attach a 2-line pointer in the pre-read?

Jon: Sure — will add `kernel-checklist.md` link and 2 bullets.

Taylor: One more ask: add a small rollout/fallback policy item (5m) — we've had a couple of near-misses on capacity fallback. Not full discussion, just align on who owns rollbacks.

Sam: Good call — squeeze it into the triage slot as a 5m micro-item, then triage for owners.

Gabi: Can we move the meeting to 9:30 once for timezone overlap with EMEA? I have a high conflict at 10.

Lee: 9:30 would work for me but might block a few others. Anyone object?

Nina: 9:30 is fine from my side.

Sam: I prefer to keep it at 10 for consistency. If it becomes recurring problem we can rotate times next quarter. For this week I'll keep 10 — Lee if you still canfacilitate at 10?

Lee: Yep, I can do 10. I'll update the calendar and post the agenda in #eng-platform by EOD tomorrow.

InfraBot: Created calendar update: Thu 10:00-10:45 — Standards Sync. Organizer: Lee. Link: https://calendar.redwood/events/abc123

Sam: Thank you all — Nina please drop the pre-read in the thread when ready and tag `@eng-platform` so folks can review.

Nina: Will do, aiming for EOD Tues.

Taylor: :thumbsup:

Lee: I'll run the facilitator checklist and keep timers. If anyone has hard blocking items, DM me — otherwise see you Thu.

Sam: Leaving notes for handover: facilitation checklist -> keep RFC timer, call for last call after each item, note followups to triage board. Copy paste for the doc: ```
- Start on time
- Intro 1m
- Item owner 3-5m summary
- Q&A 10-15m
- Decision / next steps 2m
- Assign followups to triage
```

Gabi: Thanks Sam, nice checklist. :sparkles:
